title: AI Stackprint models
description: Model context sizes, prices and retirement dates. default/models.json is generated weekly from LiteLLM by .github/workflows/models.yml (do not edit it by hand); ~/.ai-stackprint/models.json holds your changes in the same shape, every field optional.

version.description: Format version of this file (not the app version).

updated.description: Date the data was taken (YYYY-MM-DD). Between the built-in and the downloaded copy, the newer one is used.

models.description: Key = model name as the provider and the apps' logs write it. A logged name uses the longest key it contains.

provider.description: custom: a model you added (your file only).

above.description: Long-context tiers, lowest threshold first. A request whose input is over 'tokens' is priced at the tier for all of its tokens; a field the tier leaves out uses the base price.

multipliers.description: Price multipliers for modes the logs can show: fast (fast mode), us (US-only processing).

retires.description: The provider stops serving the model on this date.

successor.description: Suggested replacement (a key of models when known).

source.description: Provider page the price comes from.

price.description: USD per 1,000,000 tokens. A missing field means unknown, not free; 0 means free. The generated file always has input and output.

tokens.description: Input tokens (input + cache read + cache write) of one request above which this tier applies.
